values: Proposed catalog workflow for human and AI editing.
Layout example. Draft content. Not compatible with the current Nexus importer.
This workbook demonstrates the proposed three-sheet layout. It does not update Nexus or publish any listings.
The existing transfer workflow supports Amazon and eBay. This new layout and its Shopify/Etsy adapters still need implementation.
Keep shared facts on Products. Preserve SKU and parent identity. Add only values supported by product documents or verified records.
Reuse each approved translation across compatible destinations. Language is independent of country. Add regional locales only when needed.
Use an override only when that listing needs a different value. Omitted overrides leave current data unchanged.
Choose the precise account or shop and any applicable marketplace. Do not infer a marketplace from the language or invent one for a shop.
An exported listing key distinguishes multiple listings for the same SKU and destination. The sample uses an illustrative primary key.
A blank without an explicit operation preserves existing data. Deletion must be explicit. CLEAR and INHERIT are available in Listing overrides.
SET needs a value. CLEAR and INHERIT need an empty value. Nexus must check field support and required values before accepting either operation.
Resolve only configured inheritance for that field, SKU, language and destination. Never silently substitute the wrong language or product facts.
Provide evidence and only the fields that need work. Keep unknown facts blank and record the evidence needed. Do not invent materials, weights or certifications.
Prefer structured drafts sent directly to Nexus for ongoing work. Use this workbook for portable editing. Both paths should share one validation and review process.
Review changed values, their sources and the affected destinations. Product facts and language quality need review beyond type and length checks.
Production exports must preserve stable record IDs, schema versions and record versions. These managed values are omitted from this layout illustration.
Dropdowns help editing but do not prove a combination is valid. This example provides basic lists, not dependent channel schemas or live validation.
Applying catalog changes and publishing to a channel are separate steps. Channel-specific validation and channel responses must determine publication status.
Do not use formulas to assert readiness or invent facts. The example needs no calculations. Validate derived values and units in the production import path.
SKU identities and parent relationships come from the Gale export dated 7 September 2026. Brand, model, copy and destinations here are illustrative.
Material, weight and other unverified specifications are deliberately blank. No live marketplace schema or account acceptance is demonstrated.
